build_bm_python_from_graph: build a python module that compiles a BMGraphBuilder into executable Bean Machine Python code using to_bm_python
create_tobmpython_compiler: create a ToBMPython compiler instance from a BMGraphBuilder to generate probabilistic program code
generate_distribution_code: generate Python code for Bernoulli, Beta, and Normal distribution nodes mapped to torch distributions
generate_operator_code: generate Python code for multiplication, addition, and division operator nodes mapped to torch operators
review_tobmpython_class: review the ToBMPython class methods for generating constants, distributions, samples, operators, queries, and observations
